title.narrative: We Effect CSO Co-Power Oct 2025 - Dec 2028
We Effect CSO Co-Power okt 2025 - dec 2028

description.narrative:
Det finns mål på flera nivåer i insatsen; partnerorganisationernas insatser, de fem delprogrammen och den övergripande globala programnivån. We Effect avser att rapportera resultat på såväl den globala nivån som på delprogramsnivå.
Ansökan har utvecklats och skrivits på engelska. Eftersom målformuleringar är svåra att översätta korrekt och för att underlätta kommande resultatuppföljning återges målen på engelska nedan.
ÖVERGRIPANDE PROGRAMNIVÅ
Impact (lånsiktigt effektmål) At all times every woman, man and child has the physical and economic access to adequate food or means for its procurement
Overall Programme Objective (övergripande programmål) Strong, inclusive and democratic cooperatives, member-based organisations and other civil society organisations actively contribute to the realisation of right to food, strengthened resilience, and sustainable livelihoods for their members and communities, while also promoting an enabling environment for civil society.
Systemförändringar som bidrar till det övergripande programmålet sker på tre nivåer; i) individ-/hushålls-/lokalsamhällesnivå, ii) organisationsnivå samt iii) institutionell nivå och i samhället i stort. Indikatorer för dessa tre nivåer är inkluderade i det övergripande resultatramverket.
Programmet är strukturerat kring fem sammanlänkade resultatområden (results areas) för vilka effekter på kort och medellång sikt (outcomes) formulerats.
Result Area 1: Stronger Civil Society Partner Organisations (starkare civilsamhällespartnerorganisationer) Outcome 1.1: Partner organisations develop into strong, sustainable, rights-based, democratic, inclusive, environmentally sustainable and climate smart, and gender responsive entities that increasingly provide members and rights-holders with demand driven products and services.
Outcome 1.2: Partner organisations have strengthened capacity to organise their members and rights holders to advocate for structural change and an enabling environment for civil society.
Result Area 2: Gender Equality and Women's Rights (jämställdhet och kvinnors rättigheter) Outcome 2.1: Partner organisations and We Effect contribute to changing contextually identified harmful and constraining norms and practises that act as barriers to accessing gender equality and women's rights, thereby fostering a more inclusive and equitable society
Result Area 3: Resilience, climate change and a healthy environment (resiliens, klimatförändringar och en hälsosam miljö) Outcome 3.1: Partner organisations and We Effect enable smallholder farmers, particularly women and indigenous peoples, to adopt sustainable agriculture and land management practices, such as agroecology, and strengthen their resilience to climate induced shocks and stresses, leading to a healthier, safer, and more sustainable environment that supports the realisation of the right to food
Result Area 4: Sustainabel Livelihoods (hållbara försörjningsmöjligheter) Outcome 4.1: Smallholder farmers, women, and youth involved in We Effects programmes improve their sustainable livelihoods characterised by increased income from diversified sources, strengthened resilience to shocks and stresses, and equitable participation in economic and social activities through access to skills, capital, land and markets.
Outcome 4.2: Women and young people in We Effects programmes increase their equitable access to financial services, enabling them to invest in businesses and diversify their income sources, and have improved economic resilience.
Result Area 5: Effective, equitable and just food systems (effektiva, jämlika och rättvisa livsmedelssystem) Outcome 5.1: Smallholder farmers and their organisations increasingly participate in more efficient, gender inclusive, environmentally sustainable and climate smart agricultural value chains and just food systems.
DELPROGRAMNIVÅ Delprogrammen har följande övergripande mål (dessa är hämtade från ansökans bilaga 1 i vilken programmen beskrivs narrativt):
Programme 1 - Southern Africa - Southern African Food and Economic Empowerment Programme (SAFEE) Objective: Strong, inclusive and democratic cooperatives, member-based organisations and other civil society organisations contribute to the right to food, women's economic empowerment and strengthened economic and environmental resilience and sustainable livelihoods for their members and communities.
Programme 2 - Latin America - Sowing Opportunities: Equality and the Right to Food for Resilient Development Objective: Empower CSOs to promote fair, inclusive, and sustainable rural development, advancing economic, social, and cultural rights and the right to food for rural, indigenous, Afro-descendant women and youth in Latin America - particularly in Honduras, El Salvador, Guatemala, Bolivia and Colombia.
Programme 3 - Eastern Africa - Livelihood and Right to Food Programme Objective: To realise empowered, resilient, gender responsive partner organisations contributing to the right to food, job creation and sustainable livelihoods for their members in Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda by 2030.
Programme 4 - Palestine - Together for Food Security in Palestine Objective: By 2030, participating organisations will be actively contributing to just, resilient, and sustainable rural development in Palestine, being a voice and providing quality servies and ensuring the right to food for their members, with a special focus on women and young people.
Programme 5 - Europe - Empowering and unifying rural communities and organisations through partnerships for an equal and sustainable future Objective: Capacitated CSOs are empowered to steer the process of creating democratic societies, hence, transparently and effectively guiding the rural economic development agenda and reducing poverty and oppression.

Implemented across 17 countries, the Co-Power Programme includes three multi-country programmes in Southern Africa, Eastern Africa and Latin America, a regional programme in Europe, and a country programme in Palestine.
Supporting 88 civil society partner organisations—mainly cooperatives, member-based organisations, and women’s rights groups—the programme seeks to strengthen inclusive, democratic, and resilient communities that realise the right to food and sustainable livelihoods. It works through five result areas: stronger organisations; gender equality and women’s rights; resilience and climate justice; sustainable livelihoods; and equitable, just food systems.
Grounded in a human rights-based approach, Co-Power focuses on building partners’ organisational and business capacity, advancing internal democracy, combating corruption, and promoting financial inclusion. By empowering smallholder farmers, women, youth, and other marginalised groups, the programme aims to enhance incomes, market access, job creation, and food security while fostering long-term, sustainable development.

Programmet genomförs i 17 länder och omfattar tre program i södra Afrika, östra Afrika och Latinamerika, ett regionalt program i Europa samt ett landprogram i Palestina.
Programmet stödjer 88 civilsamhällesorganisationer – främst kooperativ, medlemsbaserade organisationer och kvinno­rättsorganisationer – med målet att stärka inkluderande, demokratiska och motståndskraftiga samhällen som förverkligar rätten till mat och hållbara försörjningsmöjligheter. Det arbetar inom fem resultatområden: starkare organisationer; jämställdhet och kvinnors rättigheter; resiliens och klimaträttvisa; hållbara försörjningsmöjligheter; samt rättvisa och hållbara livsmedelssystem.
Med en rättighetsbaserad ansats fokuserar Co-Power på att stärka partnerorganisationernas organisatoriska och affärsmässiga kapacitet, utveckla intern demokrati, motverka korruption och främja finansiell inkludering. Genom att stärka småskaliga jordbrukare, kvinnor, ungdomar och andra marginaliserade grupper bidrar programmet till ökade inkomster, bättre marknadstillgång, fler arbetstillfällen och ökad livsmedelssäkerhet – samtidigt som det främjar långsiktig, hållbar utveckling.
